Merged to main as PR #2 (merge commit ed62910). Merged tree verified green: 13 packages, 0 failed.

Both fabricating handlers deleted; gates carried through the loader and enforced as two distinct gates; declared outputs validated before completion; gate-review records bound by sha256 with re-hash invalidation; the halt made durable across invocations.

Limitation on the record: the anti-fabrication regression tests are name- and text-based. They catch the old handlers under the same registry keys or those exact phrases returning; they would NOT catch a differently-worded fabricator under a new stage name.

Done as tasks 1-2 of the avg-pm8 branch (commits e23bba0, 2b6a59a, fae0c7c). The writer now emits the schema's envelope — apiVersion, kind, evt_ ULID id, episodeRef, data, stageId inside the payload — and a contracts test runs REAL writer output through ajv, which is the check whose absence let the two drift. parseJournal gained a strict mode for callers deriving state from the log. The gateway's redundant attempt-recorded write was deleted. A later fix wave added required-field checks for the five execution payloads, closing the same drift one layer down.

Merged to main as PR #3 (merge commit a3b5f83). Merged tree verified: contracts 116, runtime 360, gateway 278, all green.

Delivered: the journal writer conforms to its schema with real-output ajv conformance testing; execution-event payload schema with required leaseId/attemptNumber; deriveExecutionState replaying the journal deterministically and failing closed on undeclared stages, unopened attempts and forbidden transitions; lease expiry applied during replay so a crashed holder's stage becomes retryable rather than locked; and a filesystem Lock implementing the port that had only ever had a test fixture.

On the record: this slice has no production caller. avg-tt7 is its consumer.

Merged to main as PR #4 (merge commit 861141f). Merged tree verified: contracts 116, runtime 410 across 36 files, gateway 278, agent 184 — all green.

Delivered: ExecutionService with one meaning for run/status/rerun; state from journal replay with no file-existence inference; dispatch and budget as injected ports so absence is refusal; the fail-closed matrix; dry run that sees every gate and returns would-run; rerun that pre-validates its ids.

Fixed along the way, each reproduced first: a failed stage never released its lease (pre-existing); one dispatcher failure deadlocked the whole episode; the retry cap counted successes; and a late write after a lease takeover made an episode permanently underivable.

On the record: ships with no production caller. avg-2n7 and avg-grf are what make qr4.2's acceptance criterion literally true.

Merged in PR #5 (b15ae4b). Gateway /execute now runs through the execution service; runAutopilot and its machinery deleted; 17 gate-enforcement tests re-pointed and verified line-by-line. Follow-ups filed: avg-7he, avg-qr4.3 notes, avg-grf notes.

Merged in PR #6 (f1c9732). vpr run is now claim -> dispatch -> complete through the execution service; cmdStatus and cmdRerun report the journal instead of inferring from files; the gateway's single-stage route and routes/runtime.ts (8 endpoints, 0 consumers) are gone; the agent's pipeline tools gained pva_claim_stage/pva_complete_stage and describe the service's semantics. 37 commits, 1308 tests, CI green. Four Criticals caught in review, all on paths that had zero coverage. Follow-up notes filed on avg-qr4.3 (attendance refuses claim(), so the CLI now hits that wall), avg-d43 (the three husks are on the public barrel), avg-91o, avg-82z.

Freezing it now would strand real work.

Superseded twice over. It targets root WORKSPACE.md, which no longer exists — the file is docs/workspace.md. And it asks for a flat library/channel/series/episode tree, which is layout 1; the current design is layout 2, with explicit series/ and episodes/ containers, adopted precisely because a flat tree could not tell a series from a support folder. Doing this task would undo ADR-0023's successor.
